kept.spine: A traveller says the road brings steady traffic and the spread of trades keeps more hands busy than the town needs, and that a man passing through is never long without work here. None of the prosperity looks improvised.

kept.poolKey: INCOME MIX: two or three sources between them
kept.spine: Most of what the town lives on comes from two or three trades between them. The drinkers of the district each name a different trade, and each of them is paid by the one he names.

kept.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
kept.spine: The stalls at Rundgate carry the town's own goods and other towns' goods side by side. A drover says he cannot tell the one from the other without asking, and that nobody behind a stall tells him unasked.
The yards are full of goods bound out and no two loads in them are the same. Loading them is the ordinary work of the day here, and nobody in the yards asks where any of it goes.
Rundgate feeds itself, and the margin left at the end of a season is small enough that nobody troubles to count it.
The garrison is kept on a supply that has stopped coming. The buildings stand, the men in them keep their skill, and the work waits on what does not arrive.

A little of the town's trade never reaches the under-clerks of the hall… too little to change what the place is, and enough that somebody is keeping the difference. Where that difference goes is in no account, and it would be worth knowing whose hands it passes through.
